variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Two-base insertion predicted to cause a frameshift (p.(Thr158LysfsTer26)); the paper's table gives p.(Thr158Lysfs*26), names case 4 as the only insertion, and the authors state all such variants were predicted to lead to nonsense-mediated decay (cohort-level).

quotes.quote: We recruited 11 cases with pathogenic variants in LAMP2 across five countries.
